represents: Azure Activity Log (Administrative and Policy categories) for one subscription, as it reaches the SIEM through the subscription's diagnostic setting (Event Hub, archived to storage) and a connector that polls the Activity Log REST API: Terraform running as a GitHub-OIDC-federated service principal creating user-assigned managed identities, adding / updating / removing their federated identity credentials for AKS workload identity, granting the identities Key Vault roles, deploying, scaling AKS, reading state-backend keys and tagging; automation starting and deallocating build VMs; a platform engineer editing an MI FIC subject in the portal; Azure Policy audit records; and a refused role assignment. Template weights deliberately over-sample the activity adjacent to the rules in adjacent_to (and their documented false-positive classes), so a rule's hits and rate_per_10k on this slice are corpus figures, not a production rate.
provenance: synthetic; shapes from the Azure Monitor Activity Log 'schema from storage account and event hubs' (time, resourceId, operationName, category, resultType Start/Success/Failure, resultSignature, identity.authorization.evidence, identity.claims, properties) and this repo's TRR9013 managed-identity fixtures. Casing: exported Activity Log records do not keep one casing (MS Learn, 'Activity log in Azure Monitor': values 'might have different case from otherwise equivalent values'), so every operation (T0-T19) is carried in three equally weighted record forms, with no published frequency to weight them otherwise: T20-T39, the export form with UPPERCASE operationName and resourceId (Elastic's captured Event Hub record of an Administrative action: 'MICROSOFT.EVENTHUB/NAMESPACES/AUTHORIZATIONRULES/LISTKEYS/ACTION' on '/SUBSCRIPTIONS/<guid>/RESOURCEGROUPS/...'); T40-T59, an UPPERCASE resourceId with the ARM-cased operationName (MS Learn's storage-account example; this repo's TRR9013 fixture); and T0-T19, the ARM REST / portal form (operationName.value and resourceId as ARM returns them) that a REST-polling connector emits. GUIDs keep their lowercase form inside an upper-cased resourceId, as in both documented export samples; identity.authorization and properties.entity / message keep ARM casing in every form, as in the captured record. A lower-cased operationName (MS Learn's Event Hub example, microsoft.support/...) is not shown for this slice's providers and is not modelled. Top-level category stays 'Administrative' / 'Policy' per the MS Learn property-mapping table ('Always "Administrative"'), although older samples (MS Learn's Event Hub example, Elastic's capture) carry the operation type ('Write' / 'Action') there. Tenant / subscription / object ids are random GUIDs; users are role handles at example.com; addresses RFC 5737.
